name: Gikei - Meiji Mangekyou Sekai
source:
Yukiko entered a wealthy household as the daughter from her mother's previous marriage. 

What awaited her was her older step-brother's obsessive love. 

She was tattooed as a symbol of his ownership of her, then bound as he uttered indecent words.

Her incredibly lewd nights with Shouichirou had Yukiko fall into the depths of carnality...
